raw: Act 5, Scene 1 — Mantua. A Street

sentences.en: Mantua. A Street
sentences.ko: 만토바의 거리

summary.en: In Mantua, Romeo hears that Juliet is dead. He buys poison and goes back to Verona to die beside her.
summary.ko: 만토바에서 로미오는 줄리엣이 죽었다는 소식을 듣는다. 그는 독약을 사서 줄리엣 곁에서 죽으려고 베로나로 돌아간다.

raw: Enter Romeo.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
If I may trust the flattering eye of sleep,
My dreams presage some joyful news at hand.
My bosom’s lord sits lightly in his throne;
And all this day an unaccustom’d spirit
Lifts me above the ground with cheerful thoughts.
I dreamt my lady came and found me dead,—
Strange dream, that gives a dead man leave to think!—
And breath’d such life with kisses in my lips,
That I reviv’d, and was an emperor.
Ah me, how sweet is love itself possess’d,
When but love’s shadows are so rich in joy.

sentences.en: If I can trust the sweet promises of sleep, my dreams tell me happy news is coming.
sentences.ko: 잠이 주는 달콤한 약속을 믿어도 된다면, 내 꿈은 곧 기쁜 소식이 온다고 말해 준다.

sentences.en: My heart feels light today.
sentences.ko: 오늘 내 마음은 가볍다.

sentences.en: And all day long, a new feeling lifts me up with happy thoughts.
sentences.ko: 온종일 새로운 기분이 즐거운 생각으로 나를 들뜨게 한다.

sentences.en: I dreamed my lady came and found me dead.
sentences.ko: 내 사랑이 찾아와 죽어 있는 나를 발견하는 꿈을 꾸었다.

sentences.en: Strange dream, where a dead man can still think!
sentences.ko: 죽은 자가 생각할 수 있다니, 참으로 묘한 꿈이다!

sentences.en: She breathed life into my lips with kisses.
sentences.ko: 그녀는 입맞춤으로 내 입술에 생명을 불어넣었다.

sentences.en: Then I came back to life.
sentences.ko: 그러자 나는 다시 살아났다.

sentences.en: And I was an emperor.
sentences.ko: 그리고 나는 황제가 되었다.

sentences.en: Oh, how sweet love itself is, when even the shadows of love are so full of joy.
sentences.ko: 오, 사랑의 그림자조차 이토록 기쁨으로 가득하니, 사랑 그 자체가 얼마나 달콤한가.

raw: Enter Balthasar.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
News from Verona! How now, Balthasar?
Dost thou not bring me letters from the Friar?
How doth my lady? Is my father well?
How fares my Juliet? That I ask again;
For nothing can be ill if she be well.

sentences.en: News from Verona!
sentences.ko: 베로나에서 온 소식이다!

sentences.en: Hello, Balthasar!
sentences.ko: 어서 와, 발타자르!

sentences.en: Do you not bring me letters from the friar?
sentences.ko: 신부님이 보내신 편지는 없느냐?

sentences.en: How is my lady and is my father well?
sentences.ko: 내 사랑은 어떠냐? 아버지는 안녕하시냐?

sentences.en: How is my Juliet? I ask again because nothing can be bad if she is well.
sentences.ko: 내 줄리엣은 어떠냐? 다시 묻는 건, 그녀만 무사하면 나쁜 일이 있을 리 없기 때문이다.

speaker: BALTHASAR
raw:
Then she is well, and nothing can be ill.
Her body sleeps in Capel’s monument,
And her immortal part with angels lives.
I saw her laid low in her kindred’s vault,
And presently took post to tell it you.
O pardon me for bringing these ill news,
Since you did leave it for my office, sir.

sentences.en: Then she is well, and nothing can be ill.
sentences.ko: 그렇다면 아가씨는 무사하시니, 나쁜 일은 없는 것입니다.

sentences.en: Her body sleeps in her family's tomb.
sentences.ko: 아가씨의 몸은 가문의 무덤에 잠들어 계십니다.

sentences.en: And her immortal soul lives with angels.
sentences.ko: 그리고 영원한 영혼은 천사들과 함께 계십니다.

sentences.en: I saw her laid low in her family's vault.
sentences.ko: 아가씨께서 가문의 묘실에 누이시는 것을 제 눈으로 보았습니다.

sentences.en: I rode here at once to tell you.
sentences.ko: 이 소식을 전하기 위해 즉시 이곳으로 달려왔습니다.

sentences.en: Please forgive me for bringing this bad news.
sentences.ko: 이 나쁜 소식을 전하게 된 것을 용서해 주십시오.

sentences.en: You left it to my duty to tell you, sir.
sentences.ko: 주인님께서 소식을 전하는 일을 제게 맡기셨으니까요.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
Is it even so? Then I defy you, stars!
Thou know’st my lodging. Get me ink and paper,
And hire post-horses. I will hence tonight.

sentences.en: Is it really so? Then I defy the stars!
sentences.ko: 정말 그러한가? 그렇다면 나는 운명에 맞서겠다!

sentences.en: You know where I am staying, so get me ink and paper.
sentences.ko: 내가 묵는 곳을 알지? 잉크와 종이를 가져와라.

sentences.en: Hire fast horses because I will leave from here tonight.
sentences.ko: 오늘 밤 여기를 떠날 테니 빠른 말을 구해라.

speaker: BALTHASAR
raw:
I do beseech you sir, have patience.
Your looks are pale and wild, and do import
Some misadventure.

sentences.en: I beg you, sir, have patience.
sentences.ko: 주인님, 부디 진정하십시오.

sentences.en: Your face looks pale and wild.
sentences.ko: 주인님 얼굴이 창백하고 사나워 보이십니다.

sentences.en: It shows that something bad has happened.
sentences.ko: 무슨 나쁜 일이 일어났다는 표시입니다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
Tush, thou art deceiv’d.
Leave me, and do the thing I bid thee do.
Hast thou no letters to me from the Friar?

sentences.en: No, you are mistaken.
sentences.ko: 아니, 네가 틀렸다.

sentences.en: Leave me.
sentences.ko: 물러가라.

sentences.en: Do the thing I told you to do.
sentences.ko: 내가 시킨 일을 해라.

sentences.en: Do you not have any letters for me from the friar?
sentences.ko: 신부님이 보내신 편지는 하나도 없는 것이냐?

speaker: BALTHASAR
raw: No, my good lord.

sentences.en: No, my good lord.
sentences.ko: 아닙니다, 주인님.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
No matter. Get thee gone,
And hire those horses. I’ll be with thee straight.

sentences.en: It does not matter. Go away now and hire those horses.
sentences.ko: 상관없다. 이제 가서 그 말들을 구해라.

sentences.en: I will be with you immediately.
sentences.ko: 나도 곧 뒤따라가겠다.

raw: Exit Balthasar.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
Well, Juliet, I will lie with thee tonight.
Let’s see for means. O mischief thou art swift
To enter in the thoughts of desperate men.
I do remember an apothecary,—
And hereabouts he dwells,—which late I noted
In tatter’d weeds, with overwhelming brows,
Culling of simples, meagre were his looks,
Sharp misery had worn him to the bones;
And in his needy shop a tortoise hung,
An alligator stuff’d, and other skins
Of ill-shaped fishes; and about his shelves
A beggarly account of empty boxes,
Green earthen pots, bladders, and musty seeds,
Remnants of packthread, and old cakes of roses
Were thinly scatter’d, to make up a show.
Noting this penury, to myself I said,
And if a man did need a poison now,
Whose sale is present death in Mantua,
Here lives a caitiff wretch would sell it him.
O, this same thought did but forerun my need,
And this same needy man must sell it me.
As I remember, this should be the house.
Being holiday, the beggar’s shop is shut.
What, ho! Apothecary!

sentences.en: Well, Juliet, I will lie with you tonight.
sentences.ko: 그래, 줄리엣, 오늘 밤 너와 나란히 눕겠다.

sentences.en: Let me think how.
sentences.ko: 어떻게 할지 생각해보자.

sentences.en: Evil is quick to enter the thoughts of desperate men.
sentences.ko: 절망에 빠진 자의 마음에는 악한 생각이 빠르게 스며든다.

sentences.en: I remember an apothecary, a man who sells medicines.
sentences.ko: 약제사, 그러니까 약을 파는 사람이 하나 기억난다.

sentences.en: He lives near here.
sentences.ko: 그는 이 근처에 산다.

sentences.en: I saw him recently in torn clothes and with heavy eyebrows.
sentences.ko: 얼마 전에 그를 보았는데, 해진 옷에 눈썹을 잔뜩 찌푸리고 있었다.

sentences.en: He was gathering simple herbs.
sentences.ko: 약초를 캐고 있었다.

sentences.en: He looked very poor.
sentences.ko: 매우 가난해 보였다.

sentences.en: Hard misery had worn him to the bones.
sentences.ko: 지독한 비참함이 그를 뼈만 남게 만들었다.

sentences.en: A tortoise hung in his poor shop.
sentences.ko: 그의 초라한 가게에는 거북 등딱지가 매달려 있었다.

sentences.en: There was also a stuffed alligator.
sentences.ko: 박제된 악어도 있었다.

sentences.en: Other skins of ugly fish were there too.
sentences.ko: 흉측한 물고기 가죽들도 있었다.

sentences.en: Empty boxes were on his shelves.
sentences.ko: 선반 위에는 빈 상자들이 놓여 있었다.

sentences.en: There were green clay pots, bladders, and musty seeds.
sentences.ko: 초록색 흙 항아리, 짐승 오줌보, 곰팡내 나는 씨앗들이 있었다.

sentences.en: Remnants of packthread and old cakes of roses were scattered to make a show.
sentences.ko: 쓰다 남은 노끈과 오래된 장미 꽃잎 덩어리가 구색을 맞추려고 여기저기 놓여 있었다.

sentences.en: I saw how poor he was.
sentences.ko: 그가 얼마나 가난한지 알 수 있었다.

sentences.en: I thought, if a man needed poison now, this man would sell it to him.
sentences.ko: 만약 누군가 지금 독이 필요하다면, 이 자가 그것을 팔 것이라 생각했다.

sentences.en: Selling it in Mantua means instant death.
sentences.ko: 만토바에서 독을 팔면 곧바로 사형이다.

sentences.en: I did not know then that I would be the one who needed it.
sentences.ko: 그때 내가 그것을 필요로 할 사람이 될 줄은 몰랐다.

sentences.en: This same needy man must sell it to me.
sentences.ko: 바로 이 궁핍한 자가 내게 그것을 팔아야 한다.

sentences.en: As I remember, this should be the house.
sentences.ko: 내 기억으로는 이 집이다.

sentences.en: It is a holiday, so the beggar's shop is closed.
sentences.ko: 공휴일이라 이 가난뱅이의 가게는 문을 닫았다.

sentences.en: Hello there! Apothecary!
sentences.ko: 여봐라! 약제사!

raw: Enter Apothecary.

speaker: APOTHECARY
raw: Who calls so loud?

sentences.en: Who calls so loud?
sentences.ko: 누가 그렇게 크게 부릅니까?

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
Come hither, man. I see that thou art poor.
Hold, there is forty ducats. Let me have
A dram of poison, such soon-speeding gear
As will disperse itself through all the veins,
That the life-weary taker may fall dead,
And that the trunk may be discharg’d of breath
As violently as hasty powder fir’d
Doth hurry from the fatal cannon’s womb.

sentences.en: Come here, man. I see that you are poor.
sentences.ko: 이리 오게, 이 사람아. 자네가 가난한 걸 알겠네.

sentences.en: Wait, here are forty gold coins.
sentences.ko: 잠깐, 여기 금화 사십 개가 있네.

sentences.en: Give me a small amount of poison that must work quickly.
sentences.ko: 빨리 듣는 독약을 조금만 주게.

sentences.en: It must spread through all the veins so the person who takes it falls dead immediately.
sentences.ko: 마신 사람이 그 자리에서 쓰러져 죽도록 온 핏줄에 퍼지는 것이어야 하네.

sentences.en: It must empty the body of breath as violently as gunpowder bursts out of a cannon.
sentences.ko: 대포에서 화약이 터져 나가듯 몸에서 숨을 거칠게 비워 내야 하네.

speaker: APOTHECARY
raw:
Such mortal drugs I have, but Mantua’s law
Is death to any he that utters them.

sentences.en: I have such deadly drugs.
sentences.ko: 그런 치명적인 약들이 있습니다.

sentences.en: But Mantua's law says death to anyone who sells them.
sentences.ko: 하지만 만토바 법에 따르면 그것을 파는 자는 사형입니다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
Art thou so bare and full of wretchedness,
And fear’st to die? Famine is in thy cheeks,
Need and oppression starveth in thine eyes,
Contempt and beggary hangs upon thy back.
The world is not thy friend, nor the world’s law;
The world affords no law to make thee rich;
Then be not poor, but break it and take this.

sentences.en: Are you so poor and full of misery that you are afraid to die?
sentences.ko: 그렇게 가난하고 비참하면서 죽는 게 두려운가?

sentences.en: Hunger is in your cheeks.
sentences.ko: 자네 뺨에는 굶주림이 배어 있네.

sentences.en: Need and oppression starve your eyes.
sentences.ko: 궁핍과 억압이 자네 눈을 굶주리게 하네.

sentences.en: Contempt and poverty hang on your back.
sentences.ko: 멸시와 가난이 자네 등에 매달려 있네.

sentences.en: The world is not your friend, nor is the law of the world.
sentences.ko: 세상은 자네 편이 아니고, 세상의 법도 마찬가지네.

sentences.en: The world offers no law to make you rich.
sentences.ko: 세상에는 자네를 부자로 만들어 줄 법이 없네.

sentences.en: Then do not be poor. Break the law and take this.
sentences.ko: 그러니 가난하게 살지 말게. 법을 어기고 이걸 받게.

speaker: APOTHECARY
raw: My poverty, but not my will consents.

sentences.en: My poverty agrees, but my will does not.
sentences.ko: 제 가난은 동의하지만, 제 의지는 그렇지 않습니다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw: I pay thy poverty, and not thy will.

sentences.en: I am paying your poverty, not your will.
sentences.ko: 나는 자네 의지가 아니라 자네 가난에 돈을 치르는 걸세.

speaker: APOTHECARY
raw:
Put this in any liquid thing you will
And drink it off; and, if you had the strength
Of twenty men, it would despatch you straight.

sentences.en: Put this in any liquid.
sentences.ko: 이것을 아무 액체에나 타십시오.

sentences.en: Then drink it.
sentences.ko: 그리고 그것을 마십시오.

sentences.en: If you had the strength of twenty men, it would kill you instantly.
sentences.ko: 손님께 스무 사람의 힘이 있다 해도 곧바로 숨이 끊어질 것입니다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
There is thy gold, worse poison to men’s souls,
Doing more murder in this loathsome world
Than these poor compounds that thou mayst not sell.
I sell thee poison, thou hast sold me none.
Farewell, buy food, and get thyself in flesh.
Come, cordial and not poison, go with me
To Juliet’s grave, for there must I use thee.

sentences.en: Here is your gold, which is a worse poison to people's souls.
sentences.ko: 여기 자네 금화일세. 사람의 영혼에는 이게 더 지독한 독이지.

sentences.en: It causes more death in this hateful world.
sentences.ko: 이 증오스러운 세상에서 더 많은 죽음을 부르네.

sentences.en: It kills more than these poor mixtures that you are not allowed to sell.
sentences.ko: 자네가 팔지 못하게 금지된 이 초라한 약보다 더 많은 사람을 죽이지.

sentences.en: I am selling you poison, but you have sold me none.
sentences.ko: 독을 파는 건 나일세. 자네는 내게 아무것도 팔지 않았네.

sentences.en: Goodbye. Buy some food and make yourself healthy.
sentences.ko: 잘 있게. 먹을 것을 사서 살 좀 찌우게.

sentences.en: Come, you are a medicine, not a poison.
sentences.ko: 자, 너는 독이 아니라 약이로구나.

sentences.en: Go with me to Juliet's grave because I must use it there.
sentences.ko: 나와 함께 줄리엣의 무덤으로 가자. 거기서 너를 써야 하니까.

raw: Exeunt.
